findings.title: SSRF guard vulnerable to DNS rebinding
findings.recommendation: Pin outbound connections to the validated IP while preserving Host/SNI and revalidate every redirect.

findings.title: Unbounded knowledge-base upload and decompression
findings.recommendation: Enforce request and file limits before buffering, validate MIME/magic bytes, and sandbox bounded extraction.

findings.title: Rate limiter fails open and trusts forwarded IP headers
findings.recommendation: Use an atomic shared limiter and derive client IP only from a trusted proxy chain.

findings.title: CSRF protection relies primarily on SameSite
findings.recommendation: Validate Origin and Fetch Metadata for unsafe methods and add a CSRF token.

findings.title: Long-lived JWT sessions are not revoked after password changes
findings.recommendation: Include and verify a server-side session version and rotate shorter-lived sessions.

findings.title: Content Security Policy allows inline scripts
findings.recommendation: Replace unsafe-inline with per-request nonces or hashes.

findings.title: KYC files validated by extension only
findings.recommendation: Validate magic bytes/MIME and sanitize Content-Disposition filenames.

findings.title: Predictable default Meta verification token
findings.recommendation: Remove the default and fail closed until an explicit random token is configured.
